sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy remains the undisputed market leader with a dominant 0.933 momentum score, while Healthcare and Financials gain ground to join it as the only all-green sectors.

The US equity market exhibits narrow leadership, with only 3 of 11 sectors achieving all-green status (positive across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD periods). Energy continues to show sustained strength as the top sector across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, supported by a leading momentum score of 0.933. Healthcare (momentum 0.750) and Financials (momentum 0.700) are rotating upward, with both sectors climbing 1 spot in rank over the last five sessions to secure their all-green positions.

Conversely, defensive and rate-sensitive sectors are fading. Industrials (rank 5), Real Estate (rank 7), and Utilities (rank 10) each dropped 1 spot over the past five sessions. Utilities remains pinned near the bottom of the momentum curve at 0.183, while Consumer Cyclical sits at the absolute bottom of the rankings (rank 11) with a weak momentum score of 0.233.

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 3 of 11 sectors—Energy, Healthcare, and Financials—are currently all-green, indicating highly concentrated positive performance across all timeframes.
* **Sustained Leadership:** Energy is the sole sector demonstrating sustained strength across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows, leading the market with a momentum score of 0.933.
* **High-Momentum Trio:** The all-green group is anchored by strong momentum profiles: Energy at 0.93, Healthcare at 0.75, and Financials at 0.70.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Upward Rotation:** Communication Services (+1 spot to rank 9, momentum 0.40), Financials (+1 spot to rank 6, momentum 0.70), and Healthcare (+1 spot to rank 4, momentum 0.75) led the gainers over the last 5 sessions.
* **Slipping Sectors:** Industrials (down to rank 5, momentum 0.25), Real Estate (down to rank 7, momentum 0.33), and Utilities (down to rank 10, momentum 0.18) were the week's top losers, each dropping 1 spot.
* **Momentum Polarisation:** A wide gap persists between top-tier momentum leaders like Energy (0.933) and Technology (0.667, rank 2) versus lagging sectors like Utilities (0.183) and Consumer Cyclical (0.233).

## Divergences
* **Stable Leadership:** There are no fragile all-green sectors identified, indicating that the positive trends in Energy, Healthcare, and Financials are currently stable and backed by consistent performance.
* **Rank and Momentum Alignment:** High-ranking YTD sectors show strong alignment with current momentum scores, with Energy (rank 1, momentum 0.933) and Technology (rank 2, momentum 0.667) confirming their leading positions.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Marine Shipping continue to dominate high-momentum leadership, but narrow market breadth (only 16 of 144 groups all-green) is accompanied by defensive rotations into Medical Distribution, Regulated Water, and Regional Banks.

The market exhibits highly concentrated leadership, with only 11% of industry groups (16 of 144) maintaining all-green status across all time horizons. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.99) and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.91) remain the absolute pillars of strength, supported by sustained performance in Agricultural Inputs, Biotechnology, and Reinsurance. 

Meanwhile, rotation is visible as capital moves into defensive and financial pockets. Medical Distribution (+21 spots) and Utilities - Regulated Water (+19 spots) surged, while Regional Banks gained 17 spots. Conversely, clean energy and commodity plays are fading, with Uranium (-21 spots) and Utilities - Renewable (-17 spots) experiencing sharp rank declines, and metals like Gold and Copper slipping in rank despite relatively high momentum.

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 16 of 144 groups are all-green (positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD), highlighting a highly concentrated market.
* **Energy & Shipping Lead:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.99), Marine Shipping (momentum 0.91), and Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.85) lead the all-green list.
* **Sustained Performers:** Groups maintaining top-tier status across 1-, 3-, and 6-month ranks include Biotechnology, Insurance - Reinsurance, Health Information Services, and Software - Infrastructure.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Medical Distribution jumped 21 spots to rank 58 (momentum 0.77), followed closely by Utilities - Regulated Water (+19 spots, rank 62, momentum 0.67) and Regional Banks (+17 spots, rank 57, momentum 0.69).
* **Sharpest Decliners:** Uranium fell 21 spots to rank 75 (momentum 0.36), while Utilities - Renewable dropped 17 spots to rank 104 (momentum 0.24).
* **Momentum Extremes:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.991) and Marine Shipping (0.913) lead the board, while Airports & Air Services (0.083) and Footwear & Accessories (0.100) remain anchored at the bottom.

## Divergences
* **Fading Commodities:** High-momentum metal and fuel groups are slipping in rank, led by Coking Coal (momentum 0.62, -10 spots), Gold (momentum 0.69, -9 spots), and Copper (momentum 0.66, -8 spots).
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Discount Stores jumped 18 spots to rank 87 despite a low momentum score of 0.44. Other low-momentum gainers include Aluminum (+6 spots, momentum 0.49) and Auto Parts (+6 spots, momentum 0.36).
